Place a 2 ½-pound beef blade chuck roast in pot; brown evenly. Pour off drippings; season with salt and pepper. Add 1 (14.5-ounce) can reduced sodium beef broth, 1 cup dry red wine and 2 tablespoons minced garlic to pot; bring to boil. Reduce heat; cover tightly and simmer 2 ¼ to 2 ½ hours until fork tender. Remove roast; keep warm. Skim fat from liquid; bring to boil. Reduce heat to medium; cook 5 minutes. Add 3 cups frozen vegetable blend of cauliflower, broccoli and carrots to pot; bring to boil. Reduce heat to medium; cook uncovered 5-7 minutes or until vegetables are tender and liquid is slightly reduced. Stir in 1 tablespoon fresh thyme. Season with salt as desired.
